Preserved source fragment, silence, vocative or interjection; no missing English grammatical subject was introduced.

rows.en: Hokuto...!!
Mom... I'm so glad... I really am...!!
I'm sorry... I'm so sorry, Hokuto...! For keeping the truth from you all this time...!
No, Mom... As long as you're safe, that's all that matters...
rows.notes: Vega is the addressee; restores safety predicate after the emotional repeated Mom fragment.
Silent reaction preserved.

rows.en: ...That man... Altair... His hair was the same color as yours, Mom...
rows.notes: Altair is the man; e-route explicitly names him. Shared owner does not cover s-route variant full567.

rows.en: Were his eyes, too...?
rows.notes: Question refers to Altair having the same eye color as Vega; restores his eyes as subject.

rows.en: Yes... They were the same... U-uhh...

rows.notes: Wordless startled reaction retained.

rows.en: Brother... Uhh... Uh...
rows.notes: Brother is Altair; grieving address and sobs, not a missing explanatory predicate.

rows.en: ...I never knew Vega was Hokuto's mother...
rows.notes: Shinji expresses surprise at the revelation, restored as I never knew.

rows.en: She, too... Just like my brother and me... She was driven from her home planet and fled to Earth...
rows.notes: Maria compares Vega with herself and Daisuke; she/her refers to Vega.

rows.en: Yes, more than ten years before we did...
rows.notes: Answers Maria: Vega fled over ten years before Maria and Daisuke.

rows.en: And... Vega and Ogre's pilot were brother and sister, weren't they?
...That's right.
It must have been painful for Vega... Having to fight the brother she'd been separated from...
rows.notes: Altair is Vega's brother. Living separation, not death.

rows.en: Yeah...

rows.notes: Deliberate interrupted I fragment retained.

rows.en: I'll never forgive them now...!
rows.notes: Them refers to Gulfer, named explicitly in100.

rows.en: Ginga...
rows.notes: Hokuto addresses friend; intentional name fragment.

rows.en: I've never forgiven them all along, but this time I mean it! I will never, EVER forgive them!!
rows.notes: Repetition and heightened insistence retained; no new first-time forgiveness implied.

rows.en: You Gulfer BASTAAARDS!!

rows.notes: Wordless startled reaction retained.

rows.en: I'm detecting a swarm of Gulfer Machine Beasts overhead! They're descending toward us!!
Damn it, they're coming to finish us off!!
Hmph... That Dendoh... It's a stubborn one.
Th-that guy...! It's pompous guy number two from Spiral Castle!!
rows.notes: Ginga mockingly numbers Gourmet as pompous guy number two; comedic insult retained.

rows.en: Mom, go to the Nadesico! We'll take care of him!
Hokuto...!
We'll be all right! Now hurry!
rows.notes: Hokuto reassures Vega about himself and Ginga, then urges her to leave.

rows.en: Y-yes!
All units, launch immediately! Intercept the enemy units!
So you've come out...! But don't expect things to go the way they always have!
Our output's in the yellow zone!? What was that just now!?
rows.notes: Output is their unit output, and the demonstrative refers to the interference attack.

rows.en: Th-that's...!!
rows.notes: Eris recognizes the phenomenon but trails off deliberately.

rows.en: I don't know what he did, but let's hurry up and blow him away with a Final Attack!!
Got it! Unicorn Drive! INSTAAALL!!
rows.notes: Unicorn Drive is the exact source command, not Unicorn Drill. Campaign term has unestablished independent licensed English provenance.
uncertain: Independent licensed English provenance for Unicorn Drive unestablished; campaign term used.

rows.en: All right, GOOOO!!
W-wait! Unicorn won't come out!!
Don't be stupid! We got all the Data Weapons back then!!
Y-yes, but...!
Then I'll do it! File Load! Leo Circle!!
rows.notes: File Load command follows campaign_terms; independent licensed English label remains unestablished.
uncertain: Independent licensed English provenance for File Load unestablished; campaign term used.

rows.en: L-Leo!? You too!?
rows.notes: Leo is addressed directly; failure is shared with Unicorn.

rows.en: Hehehehe... It seems it worked.
#女愛称! The TE Engine's output keeps dropping!
N-no! I can't stop it!
What the hell's going on!?
There's no doubt! These are electromagnetic interference waves!
The electromagnetic interference waves that Machine Beast is emitting are preventing the Data Weapons from materializing!
rows.notes: Machine beast is the enemy emitter. Materialization prevention, not deletion of Data Weapons.

rows.en: As long as they're in this area, the Data Weapons' conversion signals needed for materialization are scrambled, and...
rows.notes: Deliberate cross-row clause continuation into127 retained; conversion signals necessary for materialization are scrambled.

rows.en: They can't become weapons or take physical form!
rows.notes: They refers to Data Weapons, continuing126.

rows.en: N-no way...!!
It's also affecting the other units' energy conversion!
At this rate, every unit except the Nadesico will run out of energy and be unable to move!
rows.notes: Nadesico is explicitly exempt; all other units lose movement when energy expires.

rows.en: C-can't we do something!?
There's only one solution...! We have to destroy that Machine Beast!!
Fwahahaha! Will your energy run out first, or will your bodies be smashed to pieces!?
rows.notes: Two threatened outcomes both retained: energy exhaustion or bodily destruction.

rows.en: Either way, you can't use your full power inside the battlefield I've created!
rows.notes: Enemy-created interference area; Battlefield treated as named field. Battlefield lowered to battlefield as literal source English field description. Independent licensed special-technique status unverified; no claim that this is an official English name.

rows.en: D-damn it...! Dendoh's energy keeps dropping!
The longer this takes, the worse our position becomes...!
But we can't retreat now.
That's right! I'll smash that Gulfer bastard before our energy runs out!
Come on, humans! I'll make this place your graveyard!
I-impossible! I was beaten by mere humans!! By mere HUMAAANS!!
rows.notes: Defeat by humans supplies the source's elided outcome; repeated contempt remains.

rows.en: O-Oyakata-sama!! GWAAAAARGH!!
rows.notes: Calls to Lord of Spiral Castle by frozen Oyakata-sama nickname.

rows.en: Damn you, Altair! Have you regained your memory!?
Vega and the children of Dendoh shattered my false mask!
rows.notes: False mask is his imposed false persona; Vega and Dendoh children broke it.

rows.en: The man who stands here now had his home destroyed by Gulfer! Prepare yourselves!
rows.notes: Altair identifies himself as survivor of Gulfer destruction and threatens the listeners.

rows.en: I don't know your story, but if you turn against us, I'll crush you!
Silence, Gyandlar! As long as you help Gulfer, I'll strike you down as well!
I'll take you on! I've never liked you anyway!
You're a fool, too! Defying Gulfer and us Gyandlar!
With that power, you could have lived however you liked as commander of the Gulfer Imperial Guard!
rows.notes: Ashura addresses Altair as the former Imperial Guard commander; no extra rank introduced.

rows.en: I have no use for a life as a puppet with my past stolen! I will live by my own will and strike you down!
rows.notes: Altair rejects stolen history and puppet life, asserts free will and vows attack.

rows.en: Then I'll bury you along with Ogre!
rows.notes: You refers to allied opponents; Ogre explicitly included.

rows.en: Like hell you will!
We finally rescued Mom! We won't let you beat us now!!
rows.notes: Hokuto speaks for the allies who rescued Vega.

rows.en: Give it up, Gulfer! Your scheme has already failed!
The prince of Fleed! Even if the battlefield is gone, I still have this power!
rows.notes: Duke is the prince; even losing interference field does not remove Gourmet's strength. Battlefield lowered to battlefield as literal source English field description. Independent licensed special-technique status unverified; no claim that this is an official English name.

rows.en: Then come on! I won't hand Earth over to those who can't understand nature's beauty!
rows.notes: Duke refuses to surrender Earth because foes do not appreciate natural beauty.

rows.en: So you're the boss of this force!
My name is Gourmet. I'm one of Spiral Castle's Three Machine Generals!
rows.notes: Three Machine Generals composes the glossary Machine General stem and source count; root confirmed Akurasu MX Machine General listings. Not asserted as an independently licensed title.

rows.en: Perfect! I'll use you for a warm-up before I storm Spiral Castle on the moon!
rows.notes: Tetsuya proposes a preliminary fight before assaulting the lunar Spiral Castle.

rows.en: Damn you humans! Then I'll make this place your grave, along with Ogre's!
Let me tell you something! Villains who say that always end up in their own graves!
rows.notes: Grave retort preserves the enemy threat and the reversal: the villain ends up in his own grave.

rows.en: #部隊名 has joined us! With all of us working together, we have nothing to fear!
You fools! The likes of you could never stand against the power of Gulfer!!
Hokuto and Vega... Mother and son have finally been reunited... I won't let you get in their way!
rows.notes: Hokuto/Vega are mother and son; explicitly restored the relationship.

rows.en: What nonsense! We of Gulfer couldn't care less about human hearts!
If we let brats like these run wild, they'll end up just like Rom!
You're the ones we can't let run wild!
That's right! We won't let you do whatever you want anymore!!
Diondra! This battle is already decided! Leave Earth along with Gulfer!
I don't know about Gulfer, but we still have things to do here.
rows.notes: Diondra speaks for Gyandlar; restored we for her side.

rows.en: So you're the one who'll have to make an exit!
You brats! I'll show you what the No. 1-ranked commander can do!
Being the top bad guy is nothing to brag about!
I'll knock you from first place all the way down to last!!
You seem quite skilled, but you're still just a frog in a well!
rows.notes: Kept frog-in-a-well metaphor: apparent skill with narrow experience; next row contrasts the entire universe.

rows.en: Can you beat me, the strongest commander of Gyandlar, which ranges across the entire universe?!
Then try me! Let's see who wins: my fists, with something to protect, or a villain like you!!
rows.notes: Kazuya contrasts fists backed by responsibilities/people to protect against villainy. Something to protect retains the deliberately nonspecific object.

rows.en: You fool! You can regret challenging the great Ashura in Hell!
Heh... It seems you've finished saying your prayers!
rows.notes: Saying your prayers preserves the death-taunt use of nenbutsu rather than suggesting a literal Buddhist ritual on screen.

rows.en: Rom Stol! Lord Gades wants you dead!
What!? Is Gades in the Heavenly Demon Castle too!?
uncertain: Heavenly Demon Castle is the glossary-derived translation, not a verified licensed English place name.

rows.en: You're going to die here! You have no need to know!
G-GUAAAAHH!!
Oh! The electromagnetic interference waves are gone!!
Our power output... It's rising!
rows.notes: Output refers to allied machines recovering after interference disappears; our supplies the context subject.

rows.en: Gourmet, your field has now disappeared...!
D-damn you! Damn you, ALTAIRRR!!
O-Ogre... Did it just help us...?
rows.notes: Ogre is the unit; it rather than assumed pilot gender.

rows.en: I-it looks that way...
But... It feels somehow different from before...
rows.notes: The changed impression concerns Ogre/its pilot; neutral it keeps perception nonspecific.

rows.en: Could he have...!
rows.notes: Preserved deliberate unfinished recognition of Altair having regained himself, confirmed by195–196.

rows.en: ...I'll explain the details later, but that Ogre is on our side.
Is that really true!?
Yes.
rows.notes: Ruri acknowledges Vega plan; intentional acknowledgement retained.

rows.en: To think that Ogre... would become our ally...!
rows.notes: Preserved incredulous trailing construction rather than completing a source exclamation.

rows.en: Domon Kasshu. You may find this hard to believe, but now I...
rows.notes: Preserved interruption: Domon supplies the conclusion in196.

rows.en: No, I can tell without hearing what happened. You've regained your true self.
A-Altair...
rows.notes: Honorific dropped by project convention; tentative address and stutter retained.

rows.en: Let's go, Dendoh! And #部隊名! We'll take them all down in one fell swoop!!
Y-yes, sir!!
The GEARs...! The two GEAR Fighters, together...!!
rows.notes: Preserved deliberate awed fragments about the two allied GEARs.

rows.en: G-Grrr...!!
Hmph! You may have broken his field, but you're still at a disadvantage!
What the hell are you talking about?! The real fight starts now!!
That's right! I'll show you no mercy, Diondra!
All units, resume your attack!
1. Dendoh or Knight GEAR Ogre shot down.@2. An allied mothership is shot down.
rows.notes: Source has duplicated Knight label; canonical unit identification used. Exactly two condition lines. Initial 420 px first line overflow. Condition-label syntax abbreviates GEAR Fighter Dendoh to Dendoh and omits is; either/or alternatives and shot-down defeat trigger survive.

rows.en: C-Captain! A group of objects is approaching us!!
rows.notes: Restored detection statement subject rather than a bare group-of-objects fragment.

rows.en: What are they?
rows.notes: Ruri requests enemy identification from Hari.

rows.en: It's Gyandlar!
What!?
Ahahahaha! What a sorry sight you are, Rom Stol!
Diondra!
Goddammit! They had to show up at a time like this!
Exactly! I'll make the most of this opportunity!
Once we defeat you here, it'll be much easier to search for the Meteo Cube...!
I'll send every last one of you to the next world! Gwahahahaha!!
Those damned Gyandlar... Meddling where they're not wanted...!
My, my. I'm helping you for old times' sake... Can't you even thank me?
rows.notes: Diondra offers help to Gourmet, then requests thanks; does not reverse direction.

rows.en: I owe you no such thing. Get in my way, and you won't be forgiven.
Hmph. Your body's hard, and so is your head. Fine... We'll do things our own way.
rows.notes: Body/head hardness pun retained: physical hardness and hardheaded obstinacy.

rows.en: Listen up, all of you! Finish off Rom and his friends right here!!
GADESSA!!
rows.notes: Provisional phonetic Gyandlar catchcry retained from campaign glossary; not the Gundam unit.
uncertain: Gadessa is a glossary-provisional phonetic cry; independent licensed English spelling remains unestablished.

rows.en: D-dammmmit...! We're in serious trouble if this keeps up!!
That thing...! We've got to find some way to defeat that Machine Beast!!
rows.notes: That Machine Beast is Giga Gourmet, whose interference remains the urgent threat in this event branch.

rows.en: Hokuto... Ginga...! Everyone...!!
I-I've detected an object descending from above!!
rows.notes: Stutter relocated onto English report opening; direction from above retained.

rows.en: A-are even more enemies coming!?
Wait, that's...!!
rows.notes: Preserved deliberate interrupted recognition of approaching Ogre/Altair.

rows.en: Huh!?
It can't be...!!
Th-that guy!?
rows.notes: Preserved recognition fragment; identifies arriving Altair rather than guessing a name at this instant.

rows.en: Th-that guy!?
rows.notes: Same recognition fragment as231.

rows.en: Brother!!
rows.notes: Brother addresses Altair; explicit kinship retained.

rows.en: Ogre's mask...!!
rows.notes: Preserved mask reaction fragment; not completed with an unsupported verb.

rows.en: So that's Knight Ogre's true form...!
rows.notes: Knight Ogre uses the canonical Ogre spelling and source-short Knight title.

rows.en: Grrr...! Damn you, Altair! You escaped from Aldebaran!!
rows.notes: Earth-only line explicitly names Aldebaran; Super counterpart omits it, so no cross-route addition.

rows.en: You've come at just the right time, Altair! Now Rom and his friends are certain to die!
rows.notes: Diondra mistakenly still assumes Altair is an enemy of Rom;238 contradicts her.

rows.en: ...I am no longer the Altair you once knew...
rows.notes: Altair refers to liberation from prior control, clarified by full399–400.

rows.en: What are you talking about!?
The chains that bound me have already been broken...
rows.notes: Altair answers Diondra: liberated from Gulfer mind control; chains metaphor retained.

rows.en: By Vega, the children of Dendoh... and #部隊名!!
rows.notes: Continues 240, naming rescuers. Retained source cross-row fragment; runtime squad placeholder unchanged.
Source exclamatory punctuation only.

rows.en: Behold! The true power of Knight GEAR Ogre!!
rows.notes: Altair demonstrates restored Ogre power; canonical unit name.

rows.en: Viper Drive! Instaaaaaall!!
rows.notes: Activation call; campaign_terms Viper Drive, elongated Install shout.

rows.en: Ngh!?
rows.notes: Context checked in full route order; natural complete spoken rendering.

rows.en: Take my blow, Gourmet!
rows.notes: Addresses Gourmet using source-short name, not expanded Giga Gourmet.

rows.en: Tch, that was over quickly! But it's about time we pulled out, too...!
rows.notes: Diondra reacts to Gourmet defeat, then calls retreat.

rows.en: Rom Stol! We'll leave this fight unfinished for now!!
rows.notes: Postpones resolution of fight; does not concede permanent defeat.

rows.en: Tch, that was over quickly! But it's about time we withdrew, too...!
rows.notes: Ashura parallel defeat/retreat reaction in both uses.

rows.en: Rom Stol! We'll leave this fight unfinished for now!
rows.notes: Ashura postpones fight with Rom.

rows.en: All enemy unit signals have vanished!
rows.notes: Context checked in full route order; natural complete spoken rendering.

rows.en: Good. Bring all our units aboard.
rows.notes: Context checked in full route order; natural complete spoken rendering.
Collapse begins. Retained unfinished source utterance with explicit I.

rows.en: H-hey, Hokuto! Ogre's...!!
rows.notes: Ginga alerts Hokuto to Ogre. Retained deliberate source interruption.

rows.en: Huh...?
rows.notes: Reaction only.

rows.en: B-brother!? What's happened to you!? Brother!!
rows.notes: Vega addresses her collapsing brother; worried question restored.

rows.en: ! Oh, no! Linda, send the medical team to Ogre immediately!
rows.notes: Context checked in full route order; natural complete spoken rendering.

rows.en: Y-yes!
rows.notes: Context checked in full route order; natural complete spoken rendering.

rows.en: Brother...
rows.notes: Brother address-only fragment in two route uses349 and363; both emotional responses fit same English.

rows.en: Vega...
rows.notes: Context checked in full route order; natural complete spoken rendering.

rows.en: Brother... You mustn't speak...
rows.notes: Vega restrains wounded brother from speaking.

rows.en: Mom...
rows.notes: Context checked in full route order; natural complete spoken rendering.

rows.en: You... are...?
rows.notes: Altair responds to Hokuto calling Vega Mom. Retained deliberately unfinished question.

rows.en: Yeah...
This is Hokuto... my son...
rows.notes: Vega identifies Hokuto as her son. Restored identification predicate.

rows.en: ...And you are... Dendoh's other pilot...
rows.notes: Altair turns to Ginga; explicit identification predicate restored.

rows.en: Yeah... My name's Ginga Izumo...
rows.notes: Ginga gives full source name, using glossary Ginga Izumo order.

rows.en: These children are the ones chosen by Dendoh...
rows.notes: Altair confirms children chosen by Dendoh; predicate restored.

rows.en: Yes...
Earth... is a good planet, isn't it...?
rows.notes: Altair addresses Vega about Earth.

rows.en: You... be happy...
rows.notes: Altair wishes Vega happiness. Retained dying/strained trailing wish.

rows.en: Ugh...!
rows.notes: Context checked in full route order; natural complete spoken rendering.

rows.en: Brother...!
rows.notes: Source name-call, cry, shock or incomplete phrase retained intentionally.

rows.en: I leave Ogre to you...
rows.notes: Altair entrusts Ogre to the boys; restored I leave without expanding unfinished delivery.

rows.en: Huh...
rows.notes: Single nonverbal surprise fits both revelation and later Midori feat uses. Intentional source hesitation, name-only address or unfinished phrase retained.

rows.en: Huh...
rows.notes: Ginga and Hokuto despair over Altair's claims; Eris comforts them and older allies explain the Data Weapons' response. Neutral puzzled reaction works in all four uses: deciding their future, grandfather knowing pilot identity, Vega identity, and Ginga's rescue proposal.

rows.en: Defeat Gulfer... Its power is immense... but you can...
rows.notes: Altair exhorts boys against Gulfer; retained unfinished confidence clause.
Context checked in full route order; natural complete spoken rendering.
Source silence retained.

rows.en: You two, too... Go to... your new contractors...
rows.notes: Immediately follows Viper Whip and Bull Horn silence. Addressed to the two Data Weapons, not the boys; source trails off.

rows.en: Guh...!
rows.notes: Context checked in full route order; natural complete spoken rendering.

rows.en: Brother!!
rows.notes: Context checked in full route order; natural complete spoken rendering.

rows.en: Don't worry, Orie. He's only fallen asleep...
rows.notes: Saionji reassures Orie (Vega personal name); male pronoun sourced Altair profile.

rows.en: But...
rows.notes: Retained standalone hesitant objection.

rows.en: I won't let him die... He, too... must not die yet...
rows.notes: Saionji promises survival; he too refers to Altair.

rows.en: GEAR headquarters will take care of him. You must do what you need to do.
rows.notes: Saionji assigns Altair care to GEAR HQ and directs the team back to duty.

rows.en: Yes...
rows.notes: Vega assents to Bright's briefing request.

rows.en: Let's go, Viper Whip...
rows.notes: Context checked in full route order; natural complete spoken rendering.

rows.en: Let's crush those Gulfer bastards together, Bull Horn...
rows.notes: Ginga addresses Bull Horn; crush and bastards preserve aggressive force.

rows.en: Brother... We will make your wish come true...
rows.notes: Thought pledge to Altair; restored we as subject.

rows.en: So please rest for now... Brother...
rows.notes: Thought asks brother to rest.

rows.en: Man, that surprised me. Leo and Unicorn were on the verge of death from Lagowe's virus...
rows.notes: Sentence spans 283-284. Retained source trailing lead-in; source-short Leo and Unicorn refer to Leo Circle and Unicorn Drill.

rows.en: They didn't just get better. They can even combine now.
rows.notes: Completes 283 thought without merging rows. Explicit they restored.

rows.en: It's called Kiba... Dendoh's new power.
rows.notes: Kiba is the resulting new power; name from glossary.

rows.en: Ginga and Hokuto's desperate cries must have drawn out the Data Weapons' new power.
rows.notes: Eris infers cries caused Data Weapon power emergence, not merely activation.

rows.en: Maybe the rest of the Data Weapons can combine, too.
rows.notes: Context checked in full route order; natural complete spoken rendering.

rows.en: If about four of them combined, wouldn't they become a Super Beast God instead of a Super Beast King?
rows.notes: Super Beast King to Super Beast God joke; source-scoped Dancouga allusion inferred from four-way combination and animals in 289. Translate wordplay, no invented franchise name.

rows.en: What are you talking about, Maria...? There aren't any elephant, leopard or eagle Data Weapons.
rows.notes: Ginga rebuts joke with elephant/leopard/eagle roster absence. All three preserved.

rows.en: ...Maria's jokes aside, Kiba's power really is amazing.
rows.notes: Daisuke moves discussion to Kiba strength; response triggers Maria complaint.

rows.en: I can see why Gulfer was so desperate to find the Data Weapons.
rows.notes: Context checked in full route order; natural complete spoken rendering.

rows.en: Oh, come on, brother! You're always so quick to wrap things up like that!
rows.notes: Maria chides her brother for wrapping up her joke too quickly.

rows.en: Speaking of brothers, that Altair was a real surprise.
rows.notes: Tapp pivots off brother word to Altair revelation.

rows.en: Who'd have thought that masked man was Vega's brother, and Gulfer was controlling his mind...?
rows.notes: Light states two discoveries: Vega sibling and Gulfer mind control.

rows.en: What surprised me even more was that Vega was Hokuto's mom!
rows.notes: Kaine regards Vega maternity as greater surprise.

rows.en: So Vega's a married woman with a kid...
rows.notes: Tapp concludes married mother. Ignored known stray closing quote/indent artifact.

rows.en: I can't believe it... With a figure like that, she has a kid in elementary school...
rows.notes: Light comments on figure and elementary-school child; physical remark preserved.

rows.en: Aren't you surprised about slightly the wrong things?
rows.notes: Ayato critiques what the trio chose to be surprised by.

rows.en: But Hokuto... What is Altair planning to do from now on?
rows.notes: Daisuke asks Hokuto about Altair future plans.

rows.en: Mom says he still hasn't woken up, so I don't really know...
rows.notes: Hokuto uncertain because Altair is unconscious; Mom is source of report.

rows.en: I see... He was under mind control for a very long time, and on top of that, those wounds...
rows.notes: Daisuke combines prolonged mind control with wounds; source trails into next row.

rows.en: It may take him some time to recover...
rows.notes: Completes recovery observation, explicit him from Altair context.
Source silence retained.

rows.en: You look like you have mixed feelings, Hokuto...
rows.notes: Maria sees Hokuto conflicted.

rows.en: It's only natural. So much has happened, one thing after another, over these last few days...
rows.notes: Context checked in full route order; natural complete spoken rendering.

rows.en: But that tough Ogre isn't on the enemy's side anymore.
rows.notes: Kaine offers reassurance: Ogre no longer enemy.

rows.en: Yeah! We've beaten Lagowe, and we've got Kiba! Gulfer doesn't scare me anymore!
rows.notes: Ginga lists Lagowe defeat and Kiba acquisition; explicit I for fear claim.

rows.en: Right. Operation Moonraker succeeded, and Giganos lost its mass driver...
rows.notes: Tapp lists Moonraker success and mass driver loss; retained trailing continuation.

rows.en: The Federation forces have occupied their lunar headquarters, too. The tide's turning our way.
rows.notes: Continues 307 with occupied moon HQ and turning tide.

rows.en: Still, you did well to break through those tight defenses and hit Giganos. This time, I'm honestly impressed.
rows.notes: Hayato impressed by defense penetration and attack on Giganos; no added sarcasm.

rows.en: About that... Actually, we weren't the ones who destroyed the mass driver.
rows.notes: Judau corrects attribution of mass-driver destruction.

rows.en: What do you mean?
rows.notes: Context follows the original s0410 event sequence; subject and action restored where settled.

rows.en: When we broke through the defenses and reached lunar headquarters, the mass driver had already been destroyed.
rows.notes: Kamille establishes destruction predated team arrival; all timing retained.

rows.en: Then who did it?
rows.notes: Context checked in full route order; natural complete spoken rendering.

rows.en: We'd like to know that ourselves. Rom's the sort who might do it, but he was with us the whole time...
rows.notes: Judau rules out Rom because continuously with team; trailing source explanation.
Silence retained for both uses.

rows.en: What's wrong, Light? You look troubled.
rows.notes: Context checked in full route order; natural complete spoken rendering.

rows.en: Actually, some strange rumors about it have been flying around inside the military.
rows.notes: Light introduces suspicious internal military rumors without asserting truth.

rows.en: Yeah... I've heard them, too. But...
rows.notes: Kamille confirms hearing rumors but hesitates; deliberate trailing objection.

rows.en: Don't keep us in suspense. If you know, tell us.
rows.notes: Tapp requests information from Light/Kamille; direction preserved.

rows.en: It seems the one who destroyed the mass driver... was the Blue Hawk of Giganos.
rows.notes: Light qualifies rumor identifying Blue Hawk; exact title retained.
Punctuation-only shock retained.

rows.en: Linda...
rows.notes: Name-only intimate address retained.

rows.en: Hold on a second! That Hawk was steeped in Giganos's ideals from head to toe!
rows.notes: Judau objects using full head-to-toe devotion idiom; next row asks why sabotage.

rows.en: Then why would he destroy Giganos' trump card!?
About that... there's another rumor about him.
Yeah... that Meio Plato assassinated Giganos' Marshal Guiltorre and fled.
What!?
That's a lie! That can't be true!!
